modalities.evidence: peripheral physiological (electrocardiography, photoplethysmography, and pupillometry) signals

output.population: 86 human participants during 4 minutes of eyes-closed resting and during performance of a classic working memory task
output.summary: Raw 64-channel EEG with cardiovascular and pupillometry recordings and behavioral responses, collected during eyes-closed rest and an auditory digit span task with serial recall.
